prompt: Create a monochrome anime-style portrait of a beautiful young woman in traditional Japanese clothing, viewed from the waist up in a three-quarter back pose as she turns her head over her shoulder toward the viewer. She wears an elegant floral and flowing wave motifs kimono with a wide obi visible at the lower left, rendered in glossy grayscale fabric with delicate embroidery and fine linework. Her dark black hair is swept into a soft updo with loose curled strands framing her face, decorated with exactly 3 visible large daisy-like hair flowers plus several tiny bead ornaments clustered near the bun. Give her a gentle, serene expression with large reflective eyes, soft lips, refined nose, and luminous smooth skin. The setting is a dark nighttime pond or river during a lantern-floating scene, with exactly 5 glowing lotus-shaped paper lanterns visible on the water: one large blurred lantern at lower left foreground, one mid-right lantern near her shoulder, one bright lantern at lower right foreground, one blurred central background lantern, and one distant upper-right lantern. Add shimmering water reflections, bokeh lights in the distance, tiny sparkling particles in the air, and dramatic rim lighting outlining her hair, shoulders, and kimono. Use high-detail manga/anime illustration aesthetics, cinematic grayscale only, strong black-and-white contrast, soft depth of field, romantic atmosphere, vertical portrait composition, no text, no color, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一幅单色动漫风格的人像，描绘一位身着传统日本服装的年轻美女。画面采用半身像构图，呈现四分之三背影，她转过头看向观众。她穿着一件优雅的 花卉与流波纹样 和服，左下方可见宽大的腰带，布料呈现出光泽的灰度质感，带有精致的刺绣和细腻的线条。她的 深黑色 头发盘成柔和的发髻，几缕卷发垂在脸颊两侧，发髻旁装饰着 3 朵清晰可见的大型雏菊状发花，以及几颗簇拥在发髻旁的小珠饰。赋予她温柔宁静的表情，拥有明亮的大眼睛、柔和的嘴唇、精致的鼻梁和细腻透亮的肌肤。背景设定在夜晚的池塘或河流，正举行灯笼漂流仪式，水面上可见 5 盏发光的莲花状纸灯笼：左下角前景处有一盏模糊的大灯笼，肩膀附近有一盏中景灯笼，右下角前景处有一盏明亮的灯笼，背景中心有一盏模糊的灯笼，右上角远处还有一盏灯笼。添加波光粼粼的水面反射、远处的焦外成像光点、空气中细小的闪烁微粒，以及勾勒出她头发、肩膀和和服轮廓的戏剧性边缘光。采用高细节的漫画/动漫插画美学，仅使用电影级灰度，强烈的黑白对比，柔和的景深，浪漫的氛围，竖构图人像，无文字，无色彩，无水印。
